card.name: Start of a past-tense verb after its subject
card.fires_on: The first piece of a verb split into parts (trans-, re-, over-, undert-, comprom-) right after its subject, where a past-tense action verb is expected. Seen in English narrative and Spanish text.

card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a verb that is about to say what someone did in the past.
